cases.name: testSingleDeclarations
cases.src:
CLASS any_class DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_name
    REDEFINITION. " comment
    METHODS another_method_name
    REDEFINITION ##PRAGMA.
    METHODS yet_another_method_name
    FINAL REDEFINITION. " other comment
ENDCLASS.
cases.exp:
CLASS any_class DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_name             REDEFINITION.       " comment
    METHODS another_method_name     REDEFINITION ##PRAGMA.
    METHODS yet_another_method_name FINAL REDEFINITION. " other comment
ENDCLASS.

cases.name: testChain

      yet_another_method_name

ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: method_name             REDEFINITION,
             another_method_name     REDEFINITION,
             yet_another_method_name FINAL REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

cases.name: testAlwaysContinue
cases.src:
METHODS method_name REDEFINITION.

  METHODS another_method_name
  REDEFINITION.

  METHODS
  yet_another_method_name FINAL REDEFINITION.

  METHODS:
    if_yet_another_interface~any_method_name
      REDEFINITION,
    if_yet_another_interface~other_method_name
      REDEFINITION,
    if_yet_another_interface~create
      REDEFINITION.
cases.exp:
METHODS method_name REDEFINITION.

  METHODS another_method_name REDEFINITION.

  METHODS yet_another_method_name FINAL REDEFINITION.

  METHODS: if_yet_another_interface~any_method_name   REDEFINITION,
           if_yet_another_interface~other_method_name REDEFINITION,
           if_yet_another_interface~create            REDEFINITION.

cases.name: testMultiplePeriods
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
  METHODS if_any_interface~medium_method_name
    REDEFINITION.
* comment line
  METHODS if_any_interface~short_name
    REDEFINITION...
  METHODS if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name
    REDEFINITION..
  ENDMETHOD.

* comment line
  METHODS if_any_interface~short_name             REDEFINITION...
  METHODS if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name REDEFINITION..
